beats.say: You buy Wheel, but you don't know Hindustan Lever made it in 1988 to stop Nirma stealing its customers.
It began with a chemist in Gujarat, selling home-made powder on a bicycle, at about a quarter of Surf's price.
lines: about a quarter of Surf's price

beats.say: By the mid-eighties, reports say, Nirma had pushed Surf off the top. Lever wasn't used to losing.
So it made a plan, and gave it a name. STING. Strategy To Inhibit Nirma's Growth.
The weapon was Wheel. A cheap powder, aimed right at Nirma's buyers.
Nirma's answer was smarter. It started making detergent's raw materials itself, and became one of the world's biggest soda ash makers. Full story on our channel.
